description: This file defines the 'Base' class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing functionality to convert numbers to their text representations in various numeration systems (bases). It implements the 'BASE' Excel function, handling both scalar and array inputs, with internal methods for performing calculations and error handling.

classes.name: Base
classes.description: Provides implementation for the Excel BASE function, converting numbers into different bases with optional minimum length padding, supporting both single and array inputs.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Performs the core conversion of a numeric value to a specified base, applying minimum length padding and error handling.
